raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "send money by Western Union"
  role subject "the user"
  role recipient "the user's nephew Andrei"
  role object "300 euro"
  role source "the post office in Harlau"
  role time "Friday"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "have a receipt"
  role subject "the user"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s3 stated
  relation "receive"
  role subject "Andrei"
  role object "the money"
  polarity negated
  certainty asserted
  valid until "today"

@a1 assumed
  relation "be located in"
  role subject "Andrei"
  role location "Torino"
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature

@q query
  where match
    relation "be located in"
    role object ?location
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q2 query
  where match
    relation "contact for a complaint"
    role object ?entity
    polarity affirmed
  end
